contradictions.what: Rep says it was decided before the room and nothing could be done, but admits fixable findings and an analysis that arrived three weeks late.
Rep calls the account healthy with no tickets, yet the customer saw declines in international markets and money left on the table.
Rep says they weren't really pitching, but answered with the Authorization Boost deck and offered a roadmap session.
Rep says nobody wanted to rip anything out and they like the product, yet the customer moved to local acquiring and asked to split.
Account called healthy and rep never met Stefan or knew of him, while Stefan says Stripe only contacted him when he said he was leaving.
Rep says there was no moment, yet a CFO decision date was relayed and the decision was made two weeks before the last call.
